calendar_source: Odia Kohinoor / Radharamana Panji & Odisha Govt Gazette

festivals.name: Basanta Panchami / Veer Surendra Sai Jayanti
festivals.odia_name: ବସନ୍ତ ପଞ୍ଚମୀ / ବୀର ସୁରେନ୍ଦ୍ର ସାଏ ଜୟନ୍ତୀ
festivals.significance: Celebrates the freedom fighter alongside Saraswati Puja.

festivals.name: Dola Purnima
festivals.significance: Swinging ritual of Dola Govinda (Lord Jagannath) and Radha; Phalgu playing.

festivals.name: Utkal Divas (Odisha Day)
festivals.significance: Commemorates the formation of Odisha as a separate province in 1936.

festivals.name: Maha Bishuba Sankranti / Pana Sankranti
festivals.significance: Traditional Odia Solar New Year and preparation of festive Bela Pana.

festivals.name: Savitri Amavasya
festivals.significance: Fasting observed by married Odia women for the longevity of husbands.

festivals.name: Pahili Raja
festivals.significance: First day of the three-day agricultural celebration of womanhood.

festivals.name: Raja Sankranti
festivals.significance: Main day of Raja Parba marked by swings, folk games, and Pitha.

festivals.name: Devasnan Purnima (Snana Yatra)
festivals.significance: Ceremonial 108-pitcher bath of deities followed by the 15-day Anasara period.

festivals.name: Puri Ratha Yatra (Sri Gundicha Yatra)
festivals.significance: Grand chariot procession of the Holy Trinity to Gundicha Temple.

festivals.name: Bahuda Yatra
festivals.significance: Return journey of the chariots back to the Singhadwara.

festivals.name: Jhulan Purnima / Gamha Purnima
festivals.significance: Balabhadra Janma and swing festivals across Jagannath and Krishna mutts.

festivals.name: Nuakhai
festivals.significance: Agrarian harvest festival of Western Odisha; Nabanna offering to Maa Samaleswari.

festivals.name: Kumar Purnima / Gajalaxmi Puja Begins
festivals.significance: Worship of the Moon by youth, launch of the Dhenkanal Lakshmi Puja festival.

festivals.name: Anla Navami
festivals.significance: Radha Pada Darshan at Sakshigopal and worship of the sacred Amla tree.

festivals.name: Rahas Purnima
festivals.significance: Observance of divine Raas Leela during the Kartika month.

festivals.name: Kartika Purnima / Boita Bandana & Bali Jatra
festivals.significance: Floating miniature paper boats in water bodies and opening of Cuttack Bali Jatra.

festivals.name: Prathamastami
festivals.significance: Ritual honoring first-born children with new garments and Enduri Pitha.
